name: Food Truck NorthWest
old_description: Our experienced consultants will help you start a food truck business plan. Learn the full rundown of how you can make a profit while managing costs.
about:
Food Trucks Northwest operates from Seattle, Washington, where founder Nick Parisi drew on more than 30 years of running his own mobile kitchen to launch a consultancy and fabrication shop. Parisi started the business after recognizing that new operators faced a maze of regulations, design choices, and operational pitfalls he had navigated alone.

The company designs and builds custom food trucks tailored to each cuisine, fabricating units that meet both road-legal and health-department standards. It also maintains a lineup of pre-built trucks for operators who want to launch quickly, and it provides consulting on business planning, cost management, and Washington Labor Industries compliance. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Clients range from first-time entrepreneurs to established restaurants and catering companies adding a mobile unit. The firm cites restaurant and catering businesses as typical customers seeking to expand revenue through on-site catering and street vending.

Parisi frames the service as a guided tour that helps owners avoid the headaches he encountered, emphasizing that every truck is engineered around the specific menu and workflow rather than a one-size-fits-all template. The company also promotes a fast-tracked path to state legalization, positioning its compliance guidance as a way to prevent fines and delays.
